title: docs(skills): the objectstack-data field-types rule teaches percentDisplay and lookupAutofill, and the fields page teaches lookupAutofill
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao1GXHCbqC69qQauk9Qizcus)_

Fixes #28256
Fixes #28246

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：objectstack-data 技能的字段类型表 `percent` 行新增 `percentDisplay`（不填或 `'bar'` 画进度条，`'plain'` 只显示数字，用于比率和概率）；`lookup` / `master_detail` 行列出 `lookupAutofill`，表下新增一段教它（选中一条记录后，把它的指定字段带入本记录，默认不覆盖用户已填的值）；文档站 `fields.mdx` 的关系字段小节同步教 `lookupAutofill`。
- 为什么改：两个键的规范与控制台都已落地（#28255 的渲染、#28245 的表单填值），但技能和文档都没教，AI 作者写概率字段仍会得到一条进度条，写报价行也不知道选产品可以带出标价。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档改动，不动代码；技能文件的 token 上限余量为零，新增内容以删除三段重复示例支付（`Select with Default`、`Email with Uniqueness`、`Lookup (Many-to-Many)`），并把 `vectorConfig` 提示并入文件顶部「不要臆造键」列表，被删的规则在技能别处仍各有一处；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`（Relational 表下的 `lookupAutofill` 段、`percent` 行、三处删除），`content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`（新小节 Lookup-pick autofill），`.changeset/28256-data-skill-percent-display-lookup-autofill.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期退出 0，`field-types.md` 读数 3206/3207。
- 需要你做的：受管面（`skills/**`，Tier H）——席位完成契约复审后，由授权账号 Approve，再由席位落地。

## What changes

Two p3 skill-teaching cards folded into one `skills/objectstack-data` PR, one commit per card.

**#28256 — the `percent` row teaches `percentDisplay`** (`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, Numbers table). The row's Config column now lists `percentDisplay` — the read-only face: unset or `'bar'` draws a progress bar, `'plain'` the number alone, for a rate or a probability. Read against `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1597` (`z.enum(['bar', 'plain']).optional()`, the describe) and the renderer `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx:978-988` (`PercentCellRenderer`: only the literal `plain` drops the bar; every read-only host draws this one renderer, the relay sites `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx:358,622,815` and `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/fieldEnrichment.ts:230` copy the key).

**#28246 — the Relational section teaches `lookupAutofill`.** The `lookup` and `master_detail` rows list the key, and one paragraph under the table teaches it: the pair shape `[{ target, source, overwrite? }]`, single-value `lookup` / `master_detail` only (`field.zod.ts:2647-2667`, the superRefine); a pick copies the picked record's `source` into this object's `target`, in the form and the line-item grid (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx:1061-1085` `fillDeclaredTargets`, `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx:3984-3991` `onAutofill`, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx:283-300` `lookupAutofillPatch`); the example `[{ target: 'unit_price', source: 'list_price' }]` is the describe's own (`field.zod.ts:2105`); `target` is a field of this object an author writes — not the lookup, `readonly` or computed — named once (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:2255-2300` `refuseDishonestLookupAutofill`); `source` is a declared, non-`internal` field of `reference` the target can hold (`packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:4156-4225` `collectLookupAutofillErrors`, the type rule `lookupAutofillTypeMismatch` at 4124); the overwrite rule — a pick fills an empty target or an earlier pick's fill, `overwrite: true` always replaces (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupAutofill.ts` `declaredLookupAutofillPatch`, the describe at `field.zod.ts:2106`); client-side only (`field.zod.ts:2107`); in a grid a declared target leaves the column's same-named `autofill` copy (`GridField.tsx:290-294`).

**`content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`** (the lookup section only, triage's one-PR exception, comment 6531273599): the relationship property table gains a `lookupAutofill` row, the code block gains a product-lookup example, and a new `#### Lookup-pick autofill` subsection before *Referential integrity* carries the same rules in full — the target rule, the source rule with the type table (same type and multiplicity; a string-valued source into a text target; `number` and `currency` into each other; a relationship only into a relationship over the same object — `stack.zod.ts:4124-4150`), the overwrite rule, client-side only, the grid `autofill` relation, and the bound that a master-detail collection whose relationship and every column are authored loads no child fields and so sees no pairs (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx:429-435`; named in PR #28322's acceptance notes as the text this card should state). It links the generated [Field reference](/docs/references/data/field), which already carries both keys.

**Changeset** `.changeset/28256-data-skill-percent-display-lookup-autofill.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, both declaration lines.

### Token ceiling — paid by deletion, never by re-wrap

`field-types.md` sat at exactly its `check-skills-token-ratchet` ceiling (3207 = ceil(bytes / 4), zero headroom), so every added byte is paid inside the file. Deleted, each with the home that still carries the rule:

- `### Select with Default` (251 bytes) — restated the Selection section's own option example in this file (label, value, color, `default: true`).
- `### Email with Uniqueness` (329 bytes) — the unique scope and the field-level `unique: true` reading live in `rules/indexing.md` § *Unique scope — always state it (ADR-0120)*.
- `### Lookup (Many-to-Many)` (117 bytes) — the multi-value lookup lives in `SKILL.md` (the Many-to-Many row and the `multiple: true` blockquote); its `max: 10` read as a selection cap, while `FieldSchema.max` is the numeric bound (`field.zod.ts:1532`).
- The vector paragraph (132 bytes) — its one rule, that `vectorConfig` is refused at parse, folds into the invented-key list in the blockquote at the top of the file (`theme`, `rows`, `vectorConfig`, `fileAttachmentConfig`); the table row and the example already say `dimensions` is the flat key.

No line was re-wrapped to buy room.

**Readings** (bytes · ceil(bytes/4) tokens · lines), base `768ec4bf` → head `0984e3e9`:

| Surface | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` | 12826 B · 3207 tok · 305 lines | 12824 B · 3206 tok · 273 lines (ceiling 3207) |
| `skills/objectstack-data` bundle, all 15 `.md` files | 163627 B · 40907 tok | 163625 B · 40907 tok |
| all `skills/*/SKILL.md` | 226235 B | 226235 B (unchanged) |

## Tests

Documentation only — no test file changes. The gates below are the verification; the skill's eval fixtures are unchanged (no eval case was asked) and the eval gate was run.

## Acceptance notes

- **Taught only what is on `main`.** Every sentence is read against the spec schema and the renderer cited above; nothing is taught that `main` `768ec4bf` does not do.
- **The skill carries the short form, the docs page the full rules.** The fully-authored master-detail bound and the source type table live in `fields.mdx`, not in the skill paragraph, which the token ceiling holds to 639 bytes.
- **`percent` row's "Percentage values (0-100)" is untouched.** The row's When-to-Use text predates this card; the storage statement (`percentScaleOf`: a fraction unless `max` is above 1) is not this card's subject. Noted, not filed.
- **Not touched:** `skills/objectstack-data/evals/*` (no eval case asked; #28435 owns `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`), `skills/*/references/_index.md` (open PR #28467), `skills/objectstack-ui` (its `autofill: false` line is correct as is).
- **Dedupe words** for the seat: percentDisplay skill, lookupAutofill skill, field-types token ceiling.

## Verification

All readings at head `0984e3e9` (= `origin/main` `768ec4bf` + the two commits).

- **Derived gates** — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` → 67 families (the docs gates included); every line run with stdin closed, exit codes landed on disk first, then `dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran FILE` → `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`. 66 families exit 0, among them `check-skills-token-ratchet` (+ `--self-test`), `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:corpus-claim-drift`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-single-h1`, `check:role-word`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `@objectstack/spec check:docs` / `check:liveness` / `check:skill-examples` (after `turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/client-react...'` under the verify lock), `check:closing-keyword-parity`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-no-major`.
  - NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET — it needs every package's `dist`, a full `pnpm build`); the diff touches no package entry. CI runs it.
- **Skill evals** — `pnpm --dir ui run check:skill-eval-tokens --self-test` (29 cases) and `pnpm --dir ui run check:skill-eval-tokens` → exit 0, `Every must_contain token is taught by its own skill bundle` (the `objectstack-data` evals still find every token they grade).
- **Tier** — `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` on the two surfaces: `claude-fable-5-1` MANDATORY (`skills/**`, no one-line exit); this thread runs on that tier.
- **Changed lines** — 112 (+66 / −46, 3 files), under the 3000 human-merge threshold (read by `--ran`).

Dogfood: not run — the title carries no `!` and `Clause-②` carries no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (CI-owned repo scan; no `.ts` touched).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (Two cards, folded by the dispatch order; one branch, one PR.)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
